title: Normalized common-stage compact support is an exact triangulated functor
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] and a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$. Let $\Omega$ be an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. For a separated finite-type morphism $f:X\to Y$ between finite-type $k$-schemes and a compactification $d$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], every normalized compact-support coefficient action $S$ [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action] has a coherent integer-shift structure on its recorded common-stage functor for which that functor preserves distinguished triangles in the categories [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. No lower cohomological bound is asserted here.

proof.text: Realize the integral compact-support functors by the actual proper/open composite with the specified quotient projections. The tensor-unit scalar mates commute with actual cochain shifts. Their full coherent-tower normalization identifies them with integral beta; rationalization identifies them with S.system beta. Finite scalar comparison and its unit, associator and shift equations retain this identification at every stage.

Restrict and rationalize the exact integral actions. The beta shift squares make these a coherent exact morphism of the recorded stage systems. Descend shifts componentwise and triangles from a common stage using prop-weil-pbc-descent-functors. The descended object and beta-conjugated representative formulas coincide with S.system.functor, so transport gives its exactness.

theorem sfCommonStageCompactSupport_exactness
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (d : Compactification f)
    (S : SfCompactSupportCoefficientAction l D.k
      (PurCompactSupport.coefficientPrimeUnit l D hl) Ω d) :
    ∃ comm : S.system.functor.CommShift ℤ,
      (fun [commInst : S.system.functor.CommShift ℤ] ↦
        S.system.functor.IsTriangulated) (commInst := comm)
